title: 把力氣留給明天
subject: 放棄一個追了八年的目標
caption: Southwestern Chinese modal pop. Wide open-air drum sound recorded in a large room, modal minor guitar figure with no chord changes for long stretches, a low male choir humming a drone under the chorus, sparse hand percussion. Plain big male lead with dialect-inflected vowels, no vibrato, no belting. 72 BPM, A minor. Spacious, conceding, not defeated. No pop production, no synth, no strings, no key change, no build.
lyrics:
[Intro - drone and hand percussion]

[Verse 1]
第八年我把那本證書收進抽屜
不是撕掉 是收進去
撕掉的話 我媽會問
收進去她就當我還在考

[Chorus]
把力氣留給明天
明天沒有要幹嘛
就是留著
留著也算數

[Verse 2]
以前我說等我怎樣怎樣 就回去
現在我說 我這個月回去
沒有怎樣 就回去
班車還是那班 司機換了個年輕的

[Chorus - choir enters]
把力氣留給明天
明天沒有要幹嘛
就是留著
留著也算一工

[Outro - drone only]
留著也算數
